**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Rule:** MFN — most-favoured-nation obligations burdening Customer.
- **Result:** The Agreement contains no MFN provision in either direction. Targeted searches for "most favored," "no less favorable," "favourable," "terms offered," "any third party," "first refusal," and all pricing terms (price, rates, compensation) returned nothing — the deal has no pricing schedule or price-matching mechanic at all.
- **Closest provision considered:** § 6.1 (p0037), which restricts the Company from participating in similar Internet projects for Deerskin Products and grants HDI the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" branded consumer site. This is a scope/exclusivity covenant, not an obligation to extend HDI terms no less favourable than those given to others or to match third-party offers, so it does not trigger this rule.
- **Position reached:** Preferred (no MFN obligation on the Customer). Per the direction guidance, nothing is flagged — and the burden in § 6.1 is left to the exclusivity rule rather than double-flagged here.
